model.name: diagram.canvasGrowOnZoomOut
model.description: R33.7.1 AC-zoom-canvas-px-grows (device IMG_4793 sharpen, architect diagnosis c725df623, expert fix 749b36335 v0.8.31): zoom-OUT measurably GROWS the SVG canvas rendered dims (width/height px)/viewBox/scroll-area - boxes keep size, the canvas grows around them = real room - NOT merely content scale. DISTINCT decl from setScale (RbPanZoom scale/zoom-range, INV-Z1 scale) - this is the CANVAS-dims grow on RbDiagramDetail (crediting it to setScale would re-conflate scale-vs-canvas = the exact false-green the sharpen prevents). Trigger = RbPanZoom.apply() growMode branch + onCanvasGrow callback (a, call-site); authoritative canvas-grow = RbDiagramDetail.applyCanvasGrow (b, the SVG-dims/viewBox grow). Composes with R33.6.2 edge-autoscroll. No fork.
